description: Land Title Settlement Department - Medagama, Weligepola D/S Division, Ratnapura District - Cad. Map No. 620174
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, locations, and ownership details) by the Commissioner General of Land Title Settlement. The content focuses on land ownership, title settlements, and property registration, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative matters.
